title: Belongs To Texas A Lone Star licking riffs like BBQ sauce off of finger tips. #smallpoems
summary: Belongs To Texas A Lone Star licking riffs like BBQ sauce off of finger tips. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Belongs
To Texas
  A Lone Star
licking riffs
like BBQ sauce
off of finger tips.
#smallpoems
